name: develop-with-worktrees
description: A local-first Codex workflow that silently defers to mature repository workflows and otherwise offers one plain-language choice with safe isolated integration.

interface.shortDescription: Respect mature workflows; otherwise choose safe task isolation once.
interface.longDescription: Silently defer to a repository's mature workflow. Otherwise ask once whether to isolate each task, use this directory for one task, or remember normal current-directory development. Isolated work uses exact-path commits, approval-bound validation, FIFO local integration, and safe deinitialization.
interface.defaultPrompt: Route this modifying Git task first. Silently defer to an existing mature workflow; otherwise follow the managed, local-choice, or single first-write question returned by the route.
